verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since such services can offer programmatic access, so the axis applies. The pack shows only interactive sign-in through a single OHID account, with no documented API keys, tokens, scopes or delegated agent credentials. The probes show only that the robots.txt files on ohiosos.gov and the filing portal returned HTTP 403; they say nothing either way about credential issuance.
